# `telemetry_db` — Rust time-series stores

InfluxDB 3 and Arrow IPC stores for every `(store.v1.table).time_series`
message of the `telemetry_db` database, on [tpp-database](https://github.com/the-protobuf-project/runtime-rs).
Laid out as the gorm target is: `mod.rs` selects the database, each schema
module holds `models.rs` and one `<model>_store.rs` per table.

Generated from Protobuf by protoc-gen-store. Source of truth is the `.proto` files — regenerate rather than editing.

## How storage is divided

| Proto | InfluxDB 3 | Arrow captures | Rust |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| database `telemetry_db` | database `telemetry_db` | `<root>/telemetry_db/` | `generated::telemetry_db` |
| schema | — (no schemas) | — | a module |
| message | a table | `<root>/telemetry_db/<table>/` | a struct and its store |
| `time_series.tags` | tags | tag columns | `<Model>Tag`, query filters |
| `time_series.time` | `time` | the time column | `i64` epoch nanoseconds |
| any other field | a field | a column | `<Model>Field` when numeric |

## Select the database

```rust
use generated::telemetry_db;

// InfluxDB 3, from INFLUX_HOST / INFLUX_TOKEN (INFLUX_DATABASE overrides "telemetry_db"):
let influx = telemetry_db::connect_influx_env().await?;
// Arrow IPC captures, no server:
let arrow = telemetry_db::open_arrow("captures").await?;
// Both: every point written to InfluxDB and recorded to Arrow.
let db = telemetry_db::mirror(influx, arrow);
telemetry_db::ensure_schema(&db).await?;
```

### `readings`

[`telemetry::ReadingStore`](telemetry/reading_store.rs) over [`telemetry::Reading`](telemetry/models.rs), from `telemetry.v1.Reading`. Reading is one sensor sample.

| Column | Rust | Kind | Role |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `device` | `String` | String | Tag |

| `observe_time` | `i64` | Timestamp | Timestamp |
| `value` | `f64` | Float | Field |
| `raw` | `f32` | Float | Field |
| `quality` | `i32` | Enum | Field |
| `samples` | `i32` | Int | Field |
| `sequence` | `u64` | Uint | Field |
| `fault` | `bool` | Bool | Field |

```rust
let store = telemetry::ReadingStore::new(&db);
store.create(&point).await?;
let (page, next) = store
    .query()
    .between(start, end)
    .device("…")
    .site("…")
    .fetch()
    .await?;
let per_minute = store
    .query()
    .between(start, end)
    .aggregate(Duration::from_secs(60), [telemetry::ReadingField::Value.avg()])
    .await?;
```
